summary: Implement expiring issue execution leases and safe handoff notices

delivery.outcome: Koru claims Planfile work for one hour, waits ten minutes before handoff eligibility, emits one deduplicated non-runnable notice and preserves fail-closed fencing authority.
nonGoals: Call GitHub Issues directly from a Koru worker

architecture.decision: Keep Planfile as the canonical lifecycle and synchronization boundary; Koru writes an idempotent status projection and never owns remote tracker credentials.
interfaceChanges: Lease expiry produces a takeover notice after 600 seconds of grace
Planfile descriptions gain one koru:living-status marker block
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket merge; existing marker blocks remain inert Markdown and Planfile stays authoritative.
